NOTIFICATION
Imp+taI, the 10th October, 2024
No. HCM/A-24/80-Estt.(V)/Pt./ a/ f 7f : A Walk-In-Interview for
engagement of 2 (two) e-Sewa Kendra Office Assistants (on contract basis) in the High
Court of Manipur is scheduled to be held from IItt1 to 15th October, 2024. Shortlisted
candidates are in Annexure – I and rejected list in Annexure – II. Those rejected
applicants may place their correction or objection on or before 14th October, 2024 during
office hour, from 10:00 am to 4:30 pm.
